ayahs.2: Kya logon ne yeh gumaan kar rakha hai ke un ke sirf is daaway par ke hum imaan laaye hain, hum unhein baghair aazmaaye hue hi chhod denge?
ayahs.3: Un se aglon ko bhi hum ne khoob jaancha. Yaqeenan Allah Taala unhein bhi jaan le ga jo sach kehte hain aur unhein bhi maloom kar le ga jo jhoote hain.
ayahs.4: Kya jo log buraaiyan kar rahe hain unhon ne yeh samajh rakha hai ke woh hamare qaabu se baahar ho jaayenge? Yeh log kaisi buri tajweezein kar rahe hain.
ayahs.5: Jise Allah ki mulaaqaat ki umeed ho pas Allah ka thehraaya hua waqt yaqeenan aane wala hai. Woh sab kuch sunne wala, sab kuch jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.6: Aur har ek koshish karne wala apne hi bhale ki koshish karta hai. Waise to Allah Taala tamaam jahaan walon se be-niyaaz hai.
ayahs.7: Aur jin logon ne yaqeen kiya aur mutaabiq-e-sunnat kaam kiye hum un ke tamaam gunaahon ko un se door kar denge aur unhein un ke nek aamaal ke behtareen badle denge.
ayahs.8: Hum ne har insan ko apne maan baap ke saath achha sulook karne ki naseehat ki hai. Haan agar woh yeh koshish karen ke aap mere saath use shareek kar len jis ka aap ko ilm nahin to un ka kehna na maaniye. Tum sab ka lautna meri hi taraf hai phir main har us cheez se jo tum karte the tumhein khabar doonga.
ayahs.9: Aur jin logon ne imaan qubool kiya aur nek kaam kiye unhein main apne nek bandon mein shumaar kar loonga.
ayahs.10: Aur baaz log aise bhi hain jo zabaani kehte hain ke hum imaan laaye hain lekin jab Allah ki raah mein koi mushkil aan padti hai to logon ki eeza-dahi ko Allah Taala ke azaab ki tarah bana lete hain. Haan agar Allah ki madad aa jaaye to pukaar uthte hain ke hum to tumhare saathi hi hain. Kya dunya jahaan ke seenon mein jo kuch hai us se Allah Taala daana nahin hai?
ayahs.11: Jo log imaan laaye Allah unhein bhi zaahir kar ke rahe ga aur munaafiqon ko bhi zaahir kar ke rahe ga.
ayahs.12: Kaafiron ne imaan walon se kaha ke tum hamari raah ki taabedaari karo tumhare gunaah hum utha lenge, haalaanke woh un ke gunaahon mein se kuch bhi nahin uthaane wale. Yeh to mahaz jhoote hain.
ayahs.13: Albatta yeh apne bojh dho lenge aur apne bojhon ke saath hi aur bojh bhi. Aur jo kuch iftira-pardaziyan kar rahe hain un sab ki baabat un se baaz-purs ki jaayegi.
ayahs.14: Aur hum ne Nooh (alaihis salaam) ko un ki qaum ki taraf bheja. Woh un mein saadhe nau sau saal tak rahe, phir to unhein toofaan ne dhar pakda aur woh the bhi zaalim.
ayahs.15: Phir hum ne unhein aur kashti walon ko najaat di aur is waqia ko hum ne tamaam jahaan ke liye ibrat ka nishan bana diya.
ayahs.16: Aur Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ne bhi apni qaum se farmaaya ke Allah Taala ki ibaadat karo aur us se darte raho. Agar tum mein daanaai hai to yehi tumhare liye behtar hai.
ayahs.17: Tum to Allah Taala ke siwa buton ki pooja paat kar rahe ho aur jhooti baaten dil se ghad lete ho. Suno! Jin jin ki tum Allah Taala ke siwa pooja paat kar rahe ho woh to tumhari rozi ke maalik nahin, pas tumhein chaahiye ke tum Allah Taala hi se roziyan talab karo aur usi ki ibaadat karo aur usi ki shukr-guzaari karo aur usi ki taraf tum lautaaye jaaoge.
ayahs.18: Aur agar tum jhutlaao to tum se pehle ki ummaton ne bhi jhutlaaya hai. Rasool ke zimme to sirf saaf taur par pahuncha dena hi hai.
ayahs.19: Kya unhon ne nahin dekha ke makhlooq ki ibtida kis tarah Allah ne ki phir Allah us ka iaada kare ga. Yeh to Allah Taala par bahut hi aasaan hai.
ayahs.20: Keh dijiye! Ke zameen mein chal phir kar dekho to sahi ke kis tarah Allah Taala ne ibtidaan paidaaish ki. Phir Allah Taala hi doosri nai paidaaish kare ga, Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.21: Jise chaahe azaab kare jis par chaahe reham kare, sab usi ki taraf lautaaye jaaoge.
ayahs.22: Tum na to zameen mein Allah Taala ko aajiz kar sakte ho na aasman mein. Allah Taala ke siwa tumhara koi wali hai na madadgaar.
ayahs.23: Jo log Allah Taala ki aayaton aur us ki mulaaqaat ko bhulaate hain woh meri rahmat se na-umeed ho jaayen aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.24: Un ki qaum ka jawab bajuz is ke kuch na tha ke kehne lage ke ise maar daalo ya ise jala do. Aakhir Allah ne unhein aag se bacha liya, is mein imaan wale logon ke liye to bahut si nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.25: (Hazrat Ibraheem alaihis salaam ne) kaha ke tum ne jin buton ki parastish Allah ke siwa ki hai unhein tum ne apni aapas ki dunyawi dosti ki bina thehra li hai. Tum sab qayamat ke din ek doosre se kufr karne lago ge aur ek doosre par laanat karne lago ge. Aur tumhara sab ka thikaana dozakh hoga aur tumhara koi madadgaar na hoga.
ayahs.26: Pas Hazrat Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) par Hazrat Loot (alaihis salaam) imaan laaye aur kehne lage ke main apne Rabb ki taraf hijrat karne wala hoon. Woh bada hi ghaalib aur hakeem hai.
ayahs.27: Aur hum ne unhein (Ibraheem ko) Ishaaq-o-Yaqoob (alaihimas-salaam) ata kiye aur hum ne nabuwat aur kitaab un ki aulaad mein hi kar di aur hum ne dunya mein bhi use sawaab diya aur aakhirat mein to woh saaleh logon mein se hain.
ayahs.28: Aur Hazrat Loot (alaihis salaam) ka bhi zikr karo jab ke unhon ne apni qaum se farmaaya ke tum to is badkaari par utar aaye ho jise tum se pehle dunya bhar mein se kisi ne nahin kiya.
ayahs.29: Kya tum mardon ke paas badfeili ke liye aate ho aur raaste band karte ho aur apni aam majlison mein be-hayaaiyon ka kaam karte ho? Is ke jawab mein is ki qaum ne bajuz is ke aur kuch nahin kaha ke bas ja agar sachcha hai to hamare paas Allah Taala ka azaab le aa.
ayahs.30: Hazrat Loot (alaihis salaam) ne dua ki ke Parwardigar! Is mufsid qaum par meri madad farma.
ayahs.31: Aur jab hamare bheje hue farishte Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ke paas bashaarat le kar pahunche kehne lage ke is basti walon ko hum halaak karne wale hain, yaqeenan yahaan ke rehne wale gunahgaar hain.
ayahs.32: (Hazrat Ibraheem alaihis salaam ne) kaha is mein to Loot (alaihis salaam) hain. Farishton ne kaha yahaan jo hain hum unhein ba-khoobi jaante hain. Loot (alaihis salaam) ko aur us ke khaandaan ko siwaaye us ki biwi ke hum bacha lenge, albatta woh aurat peechhe reh jaane walon mein se hai.
ayahs.33: Phir jab hamare qaasid Loot (alaihis salaam) ke paas pahunche to woh un ki wajah se ghamgeen hue aur dil hi dil mein ranj karne lage. Qaasidon ne kaha aap na khauf khaaiye na aazurda hon, hum aap ko ma ap ke mutaalliqeen ke bacha lenge magar aap ki biwi ke woh azaab ke liye baaqi reh jaane walon mein se hogi.
ayahs.34: Hum is basti walon par aasmani azaab naazil karne wale hain is wajah se ke yeh be-hukm ho rahe hain.
ayahs.35: Albatta hum ne is basti ko sareeh ibrat ki nishani bana diya un logon ke liye jo aql rakhte hain.
ayahs.36: Aur Madyan ki taraf hum ne un ke bhai Shuaib (alaihis salaam) ko bheja. Unhon ne kaha aye meri qaum ke logo! Allah ki ibaadat karo, qayamat ke din ki tawaqqo rakho aur zameen mein fasaad na karte phiro.
ayahs.37: Phir bhi unhon ne unhein jhutlaaya, aakhir unhein zalzale ne pakad liya aur woh apne gharon mein baithe ke baithe murda ho kar reh gaye.
ayahs.38: Aur hum ne Aadiyon aur Samoodiyon ko bhi ghaarat kiya jin ke baaz makanaat tumhare saamne zaahir hain aur shaitan ne unhein un ki bad-aamaaliyan aaraasta kar dikhaayi thin aur unhein raah se rok diya tha ba-wajood yeh ke yeh aankhon wale aur hoshiyaar the.
ayahs.39: Aur Qaroon aur Firaun aur Hamaan ko bhi, un ke paas Hazrat Moosa (alaihis salaam) khule khule mojize le kar aaye the phir bhi unhon ne zameen mein takabbur kiya lekin hum se aage badhne wale na ho sake.
ayahs.40: Phir to har ek ko hum ne us ke gunaah ke wabaal mein giraftaar kar liya. Un mein se baaz par hum ne pattharon ka meenh barsaaya aur un mein se baaz ko zordaar sakht aawaaz ne dabocha liya aur un mein se baaz ko hum ne zameen mein dhansa diya aur un mein se baaz ko hum ne dubo diya. Allah Taala aisa nahin ke un par zulm kare balke yehi log apni jaanon par zulm karte the.
ayahs.41: Jin logon ne Allah Taala ke siwa aur karsaz muqarrar kar rakhe hain un ki misaal makdi ki si hai ke woh bhi ek ghar bana leti hai, haalaanke tamaam gharon se ziyaada booda ghar makdi ka ghar hi hai. Kaash! Woh jaan lete.
ayahs.42: Allah Taala un tamaam cheezon ko jaanta hai jinhein woh us ke siwa pukaar rahe hain, woh zabardast aur zi-hikmat hai.
ayahs.43: Hum in misaalon ko logon ke liye bayaan farma rahe hain unhein sirf ilm wale hi samajhte hain.
ayahs.44: Allah Taala ne aasmanon aur zameen ko maslahat aur haq ke saath paida kiya hai. Imaan walon ke liye to is mein badi bhaari daleel hai.
ayahs.45: Jo kitaab aap ki taraf wahi ki gayi hai use padhiye aur namaz qaaim karen, yaqeenan namaz be-hayaai aur buraai se rokti hai. Beshak Allah ka zikr bahut badi cheez hai, tum jo kuch kar rahe ho us se Allah khabardaar hai.
ayahs.46: Aur ahl-e-kitaab ke saath bahas-o-mubahisa na karo magar is tareeqa par jo umda ho magar un ke saath jo un mein zaalim hain aur saaf eilaan kar do ke hamara to is kitaab par bhi imaan hai aur jo hum par utaari gayi hai aur is par bhi jo tum par utaari gayi. Hamara tumhara mabood ek hi hai. Hum sab usi ke hukm-bardaar hain.
ayahs.47: Aur hum ne isi tarah aap ki taraf apni kitaab naazil farmaayi hai, pas jinhein hum ne kitaab di hai woh is par imaan laate hain aur un (mushrikeen) mein se baaz is par imaan rakhte hain aur hamari aayaton ka inkaar sirf kaafir hi karte hain.
ayahs.48: Is se pehle to aap koi kitaab padhte na the aur na kisi kitaab ko apne haath se likhte the ke yeh baatil-parast log shak-o-shubha mein padte.
ayahs.49: Balke yeh (Quran) to roshan aayaten hain jo ahl-e-ilm ke seenon mein mehfooz hain. Hamari aayaton ka munkir bajuz zaalimon ke aur koi nahin.
ayahs.50: Unhon ne kaha ke is par kuch nishaaniyan (mojizaat) is ke Rabb ki taraf se kyun nahin utaare gaye. Aap keh dijiye ke nishaaniyan to sab Allah Taala ke paas hain main to sirf khullam-khulla aagaah kar dene wala hoon.
ayahs.51: Kya unhein yeh kaafi nahin? Ke hum ne aap par kitaab naazil farma di jo un par padhi ja rahi hai. Is mein rahmat (bhi) hai aur naseehat (bhi) hai un logon ke liye jo imaan wale hain.
ayahs.52: Keh dijiye ke mujh mein aur tum mein Allah Taala gawaah hona kaafi hai. Woh aasman-o-zameen ki har cheez ka aalim hai, jo log baatil ke maanne wale aur Allah Taala se kufr karne wale hain woh zabardast nuqsaan aur ghaate mein hain.
ayahs.53: Yeh log aap se azaab ki jaldi kar rahe hain. Agar meri taraf se muqarrar kiya hua waqt na hota to abhi tak un ke paas azaab aa chuka hota, yeh yaqini baat hai ke achaanak un ki be-khabri mein un ke paas azaab aa pahunchega.
ayahs.54: Yeh azaab ki jaldi macha rahe hain aur (tasalli rakhen) jahannam kaafiron ko gher lene wali hai.
ayahs.55: Is din un ke oopar tale se azaab dhaanp raha hoga aur Allah Taala farmaayega ke ab apne (bad) aamaal ka maza chakho.
ayahs.56: Aye mere imaan wale bando! Meri zameen bahut kushaada hai so tum meri hi ibaadat karo.
ayahs.57: Har jaandaar maut ka maza chakhne wala hai aur tum sab hamari hi taraf lautaaye jaaoge.
ayahs.58: Aur jo log imaan laaye aur nek kaam kiye unhein hum yaqeenan jannat ke un baala-khaanon mein jagah denge jin ke neeche chashme beh rahe hain jahaan woh hamesha rahenge. Kaam karne walon ka kya hi achha ajr hai.
ayahs.59: Woh jinhon ne sabr kiya, aur apne Rabb Taala par bharosa rakhte hain.
ayahs.60: Aur bahut se jaanwar hain jo apni rozi uthaaye nahin phirte, un sab ko aur tumhein bhi Allah Taala hi rozi deta hai, woh bada hi sunne jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.61: Aur agar aap un se daryaaft karen ke zameen-o-aasman ka khaaliq aur sooraj chaand ko kaam mein lagaane wala kaun hai? To un ka jawab yehi hoga ke Allah Taala, phir kidhar ulte ja rahe hain.
ayahs.62: Allah Taala apne bandon mein se jise chaahe faraakh rozi deta hai aur jise chaahe tang. Yaqeenan Allah Taala har cheez ka jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.63: Aur agar aap un se sawaal karen ke aasman se paani utaar kar zameen ko us ki maut ke baad zinda kis ne kiya? To yaqeenan un ka jawab yehi hoga Allah Taala ne. Aap keh den ke har taareef Allah hi ke liye sazawaar hai, balke un mein se aksar be-aql hain.
ayahs.64: Aur dunya ki yeh zindagaani to mahaz khel-tamasha hai albatta aakhirat ke ghar ki zindagi hi haqeeqi zindagi hai, kaash! Yeh jaante hote.
ayahs.65: Pas yeh log jab kashtiyon mein sawaar hote hain to Allah Taala hi ko pukaarte hain us ke liye ibaadat ko khaalis kar ke phir jab woh unhein khushki ki taraf bacha laata hai to isi waqt shirk karne lagte hain.
ayahs.66: Taake hamari di hui ne'maton se mukarte rahen aur baratte rahen. Abhi abhi pata chal jaayega.
ayahs.67: Kya yeh nahin dekhte ke hum ne Haram ko ba-aman bana diya hai haalaanke un ke ird-gird se log uchak liye jaate hain. Kya yeh baatil par to yaqeen rakhte hain aur Allah Taala ki ne'maton par na-shukri karte hain.
ayahs.68: Aur is se bada zaalim kaun hoga? Jo Allah Taala par jhoot baandhe ya jab haq us ke paas aa jaaye woh ise jhutlaaye, kya aise kaafiron ka thikaana jahannam mein na hoga?
ayahs.69: Aur jo log hamari raah mein mashaqqatein bardaasht karte hain hum unhein apni raahen zaroor dikha denge. Yaqeenan Allah Taala neko-kaaron ka saathi hai.
